name: iVIDyA Simple
summary: This EA uses the Variable Index Dynamic Average (VIDyA) indicator to generate trend-following trade signals. It enters long positions when price crosses above VIDyA and short positions when price crosses below VIDyA, with optional ATR-based stop loss and take profit. The strategy adapts to market volatility through VIDyA's inherent volatility-adjusted smoothing mechanism.
summary_zh: 该EA使用可变指数动态平均线(VIDyA)指标生成趋势跟踪交易信号。当价格上穿VIDyA时做多，下穿时做空，可选基于ATR的止损和止盈。策略通过VIDyA内在的波动率调整平滑机制来适应市场波动性。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于VIDyA（可变指数动态平均线）的趋势跟踪系统。VIDyA是一种自适应移动平均线，它通过CMO（钱德动量震荡指标）来动态调整平滑系数，使得在趋势明显时更敏感、在震荡市中更平滑。入场条件为价格从下方突破VIDyA时开多单，价格从上方跌破VIDyA时开空单。出场条件包括反向信号平仓、固定止损止盈或基于ATR的动态止损止盈。仓位管理方面支持固定手数交易，缺乏高级资金管理策略如凯利公式或风险比例仓位。整体策略逻辑简单清晰，但缺乏过滤机制来避免震荡市中的频繁假信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy is a trend-following system based on VIDyA (Variable Index Dynamic Average). VIDyA is an adaptive moving average that dynamically adjusts its smoothing coefficient using CMO (Chande Momentum Oscillator), making it more responsive during strong trends and smoother during ranging markets. Entry conditions are straightforward: go long when price crosses above VIDyA and go short when price crosses below VIDyA. Exit conditions include closing on reverse signal, fixed stop loss/take profit, or ATR-based dynamic stops. Position sizing supports fixed lot trading but lacks advanced money management such as Kelly criterion or risk-proportional sizing. The overall strategy logic is simple and clear, but lacks filtering mechanisms to avoid frequent false signals in choppy markets.

pros: VIDyA指标的自适应特性使其能根据市场波动性自动调整灵敏度，优于传统固定周期移动平均线
策略逻辑简单明了，参数较少，易于理解和调优
ATR动态止损止盈选项能根据市场波动性合理设置风险回报比
pros_en: VIDyA's adaptive nature automatically adjusts sensitivity based on market volatility, outperforming traditional fixed-period moving averages
Simple and clear strategy logic with few parameters, easy to understand and optimize
ATR-based dynamic stop loss/take profit option sets risk-reward ratios appropriately based on market volatility
cons: 缺乏趋势过滤器，在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号和反复亏损
没有仓位管理策略，固定手数无法根据账户风险动态调整
缺少新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上反复开仓平仓造成过度交易
cons_en: Lacks trend filter, prone to frequent false signals and repeated losses in ranging/choppy markets
No position sizing strategy; fixed lots cannot dynamically adjust based on account risk
Missing new bar check mechanism, potentially leading to over-trading with repeated open/close on the same bar
improvements: 添加趋势过滤器（如ADX或更高周期MA方向过滤），避免在震荡市中交易
实现基于账户风险百分比的动态仓位管理，替代固定手数
添加新K线检查和时间过滤器，减少过度交易和低流动性时段的风险
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., ADX or higher timeframe MA direction filter) to avoid trading in ranging markets
Implement dynamic position sizing based on account risk percentage instead of fixed lots
Add new bar check and time filters to reduce over-trading and risk during low-liquidity sessions

risk_points: 缺少新K线检查可能导致同一根K线上反复交易
无震荡市过滤器导致横盘期间频繁止损
固定手数无法根据波动性调整风险敞口
risk_points_en: Missing new bar check may cause repeated trading on the same bar
No choppy market filter leads to frequent stop losses during sideways movement
Fixed lot sizing cannot adjust risk exposure based on volatility
